authoritative_rule.test: A and B practically equivalent iff |NRMSE_A - NRMSE_B| <= delta_equiv
authoritative_rule.reading: within one SE OR within the 0.01 practical floor

floor.interpretation: 1 percent of the calibration target standard-deviation scale
floor.declared_before: any search result existed (S7.2 V1, retained by S7.2C)

se_delta.step_1: aggregate the three validation blocks within each development discharge
se_delta.step_2: compute the paired candidate difference per development discharge
se_delta.pairing: paired within discharge; both candidates scored on identical cells

superseded.v1_wording: practically equivalent iff within 1 SE AND within 0.01
superseded.defect: the conjunction made the floor inoperative exactly when it was needed: a tiny SE stayed binding and the 0.01 floor never relaxed anything

OR-02.question: is the Rank-1 equivalence set a transitive class or a comparison against the best?
OR-02.resolution: E_fit is defined by pairwise comparison against the Rank-1 best candidate: C in E_fit iff |FIT(C) - FIT_best| <= max(SE_delta(C, best), 0.01)
OR-02.authority: S7.2 V1 lexicographic wording plus the section-10 instantiation; it is not a transitive equivalence class and must not be closed transitively

OR-11.question: how is a non-finite candidate treated?
OR-11.resolution: FIT = +inf, excluded from E_fit; never re-labelled inadmissible

not_taken: any post-hoc adjustment of the 0.01 floor
domain_reading: every quantity defined here is evaluated over the frozen explored frontier Ahat_rec only; A_rec minus Ahat_rec remains ADMISSIBLE_UNSEARCHED and carries no negative finding
